title: Lean-QuantumAlg
abstract: Provides a Mathlib-based library of formally verified quantum-algorithm definitions, primitives, and endpoints, including QFT, QSP, quantum kernels, amplitude amplification, Grover search, phase estimation, order finding, teleportation, and a Lie-algebraic barren-plateau witness.

informal.QuantumAlg.QuantumFourierTransform.main: Proves the QFT action on computational-basis states and records exact circuit counts.
informal.QuantumAlg.ReflectionBasedQuantumSignalP: Characterizes reflection-based single-qubit QSP transforms in the Chebyshev basis.
informal.QuantumAlg.TrigonometricQuantumSignalPro: Characterizes trigonometric single-qubit QSP transforms in the YZZYZ form.
informal.QuantumAlg.QuantumKernel.main: Proves that fidelity quantum-kernel Gram matrices are positive semidefinite.
informal.QuantumAlg.QuantumKernelAdvantage.separa: States the conditional quantum-kernel learning separation from discrete-log hardness.
informal.QuantumAlg.fullControllability_hasBarren: Exhibits an exponentially vanishing loss-variance family for a fully controllable dynamical Lie algebra, conditional on the assumed Ragone second-moment variance law (the Haar/Weingarten averaging identity Var = P_g(rho)*P_g(O)/dim, taken as a hypothesis rather than derived from a circuit twirl).
informal.QuantumAlg.GroverSearch.main_success_pro: Derives Grover search success probability from the amplitude-amplification closed form.
